A code-span label resolves through [`Event`], a plain label through [the parser], a collapsed label through [the guide][], a full reference through [a tour][tour], and an image through ![The logo][logo].

- A loose item runs one paragraph.

  A second paragraph in the same item.

- A nested loose list follows:

  - The first nested item.

  - The second nested item.

- A tight list stays tight:

  - first
  - second

> - A quoted loose list keeps its marker alone on the blank line.
>
>   A second quoted paragraph in the same item.

[`Event`]: https://example.com/event
[the parser]: https://example.com/parser
[the guide]: https://example.com/guide
[tour]: https://example.com/tour
[logo]: https://example.com/logo
